description_en: Invokes the ListCustomRoutingEndpointGroupDestinations operation to query the destination configurations of an endpoint group for a custom route listener
description_zh: 调用ListCustomRoutingEndpointGroupDestinations接口查询终端节点组的映射信息配置列表（自定义路由类型监听）
kebab_example: aliyun ga list-custom-routing-endpoint-group-destinations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --listener-id lsr-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000 --endpoint-group-id epg-bp16jdc00bhe97sr50000 --protocols TCP --from-port 80 --to-port 80 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCustomRoutingEndpointGroupDestinations

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。最大值：50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance for which you want to query endpoint group destination configurations
parameters.help_zh: 待查询终端节点组映射信息配置的全球加速实例ID
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the listener for which you want to query endpoint group destination configurations
parameters.help_zh: 待查询终端节点组映射信息配置的监听ID
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group for which you want to query destination configurations
parameters.help_zh: 待查询映射信息配置的终端节点组ID
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type of the backend service of the endpoint group. Valid values:

TCP: TCP protocol.

UDP: UDP protocol.

TCP,UDP: TCP and UDP protocols.

If this parameter is left empty, all protocol types are queried.

You can specify up to 10 protocol entries
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点组后端服务的协议类型。取值：

TCP：TCP协议。

UDP：UDP协议。

TCP,UDP：TCP和UDP协议。

为空时查询所有协议类型。

您最多可输入10个协议信息
parameters.name: protocols

parameters.help_en:
The start port of the backend service of the endpoint group.

Valid values: 1 to 65499. The value of FromPort must be less than or equal to the value of ToPort
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点组后端服务起始端口。

取值范围：1~65499，且需满足FromPort≤ToPort，即终端节点组后端服务起始端口需小于等于终端节点组后端服务结束端口
parameters.name: from_port

parameters.help_en:
The end port of the backend service of the endpoint group.

Valid values: 1 to 65499. The value of FromPort must be less than or equal to the value of ToPort
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点组后端服务结束端口。

取值范围：1~65499，且需满足FromPort≤ToPort，即终端节点组后端服务起始端口需小于等于终端节点组后端服务结束端口
parameters.name: to_port
